items.title: Thursday Night Football: Broncos lead Seahawks 14-3 at halftime
items.text: The Broncos have stymied the Seahawks, limiting them to 91 yards and forcing a fumble.

items.title: Broncos run for a second TD, 14-3 lead
items.text: The Broncos entered Thursday night ranked 30th in total offense, including 25th in rushing.

items.title: Broncos take 7-3 lead over Seahawks in second quarter
items.text: The Broncos looked more like the Broncos of 2025 on their second drive Thursday night.

items.text: 49ers wide receiver Mike Evans has played through injured ribs.

items.title: Jon Morris, a member of the Patriots Hall of Fame, died at 84
items.text: Jon Morris, a member of the Patriots Hall of Fame, has died, the team announced Thursday.

items.title: Rams add S Kam Curl to practice report with an ankle injury

items.title: Jeremiyah Love missed practice again on Thursday
items.text: Cardinals running back Jeremiyah Love's ankle injury continues to create uncertainty about the first-round pick's availability for Sunday's game against the Rams.

items.title: Caleb Williams confirms he tore his hamstring, doesn't know his status for Sunday
items.text: Williams has had two full practices this week as he works his way back from the Week 2 injury.

items.title: Cowboys CB Joey Porter Jr. has full practice, expects to have no limitations Sunday
items.text: Cowboys cornerback Joey Porter Jr. participated fully in Thursday's practice, and he expects to have no limitations for Sunday's game against the Packers.

items.title: Thursday Night Football: Broncos CB Riley Moss is active
items.text: The Broncos will have cornerback Riley Moss in the lineup against the Seahawks tonight.

items.title: Joe Alt, Derwin James remain out of practice for Chargers
items.text: The Chargers remained without a few starters at Thursday's practice.

items.title: Chris Olave misses second straight practice with an illness
items.text: The Saints practiced without wide receiver Chris Olave for the second straight day on Thursday.

items.title: Broncos elevate S Taylor Rapp, DB Sean Fresch for Thursday night
items.text: The Broncos are dealing with several injuries in their defensive backfield, so they elevated a couple of players to help round out the secondary ahead of Thursday night's game against the Seahawks.

items.title: DeVonta Smith listed as limited in Eagles practice, Saquon Barkley still out
items.text: The Eagles announced on Thursday that quarterback Jalen Hurts will not play against the Panthers due to a blood clot in his calf, which leaves Tanner McKee in line to make the first non-Week 18 start of his career.

items.title: Texans' Tank Dell, David Montgomery, Jalen Pitre will not travel to London to play Jaguars
items.text: Three injured Texans will stay home rather than make the trip to London to face the Jaguars on Sunday.

items.title: Cowboys DC Christian Parker: Mike Pettine a "right-hand man" not a "save the day" hire
items.text: The Cowboys hired longtime NFL defensive coordinator and former Browns head coach Mike Pettine as a senior defensive assistant this week and defensive coordinator Christian Parker was asked at a Thursday press conference if Pettine is a "save the day" hire after a rough start.

items.title: With his next TD catch, Davante Adams will pass Larry Fitzgerald on the all-time list
items.text: Rams wide receiver Davante Adams has four touchdown catches this season.

items.title: Ravens add Zay Flowers to injury report as limited participant

items.title: Fox window led by 49ers-Seahawks averages 26.697 million viewers
items.text: The late-afternoon slot on Sundays continues to generate the largest NFL audiences.

items.title: Police continue to withhold the Josh Jacobs video
items.text: As Packers running back Josh Jacobs continues to spend the early weeks of the 2026 season on paid leave, the NFL reportedly still hasn't gotten access to the key piece of video generated by the incident that resulted in a no-contest plea to battery.

items.title: Christian Gonzalez upgraded to full participant on Thursday injury report
items.text: Patriots cornerback Christian Gonzalez said earlier this week that he would be ready to play Sunday's game against the Jets.

items.title: Jayden Daniels on clock debacle: "Ultimately, it's on me"
items.text: When it comes to the Week 5 overtime clock debacle for the Commanders, both coach Dan Quinn and quarterback Jayden Daniels continue to take the blame for the failure to stop the clock before a potential game-winning field.

items.title: Jalen Hurts is out for Sunday with a blood clot in his leg
items.text: Hurts developed the condition last week.
